board:
Use case: ui-mockup / logo-brand.
Edit target: the supplied game UI screenshot. Transform it into a polished art-director review board by extending the canvas around it; retain a small faithful copy of the UI panel as an inset, remove the red rectangle and red annotation arrow in the inset, and only add new icons inside its empty left bloodline section. The image is NOT a real-world biology explanation: this is a fictional game.
Primary request: design an original minimalist game icon family for GENE AWAKENING. Fiction: energy fluctuations on a new planet change human genes, awakening their power may cause mutation/evolution. Mutation TYPE and awakening LEVEL are absolutely independent: 2 types (native, mutated), 4 levels (0,1,2,3), so a mutated level-0 hero is valid. A high level is not automatically mutated.
Style: faithfully harmonize with the reference red-box attack stat pictogram: compact, flat, broad tapered angular strokes, slightly softened corners, warm graphite gray, generous negative space. Take inspiration from the compact monochrome geometric rank readability of Arknights elite emblems, but invent our own gene motif. NOT ornate medals, NOT glossy jewels, NOT futuristic HUD decorations. No gradients, glow, 3D, shadows, texture, drop shadows, wings, crowns, swords, stars, decorative sparkles, tiny microdetails, colored rarity tiers.
One coherent family:
TYPE native = a vertically compact stylized DNA double helix, two bold angular intertwining strands with just two broad negative-space gaps, balanced stable silhouette, obvious DNA at thumbnail size, no outer frame. TYPE mutated = clearly related DNA double helix, one branch breaks outward into a strong asymmetric lightning fork on the upper-right and a small integrated diamond energy core at the crossing. Mutation adds no counting chevrons. Both icons use the SAME warm dark graphite color and approximate 32x32 visual weight, distinct even in monochrome. Avoid resembling a medical cross.
LEVEL icons are a separate, visually simpler rank system with no DNA motif: level 0 = a single small hollow diamond seed; level 1 = one solid upward-pointing broad chevron; level 2 = exactly two separate identical stacked chevrons; level 3 = exactly three separate identical stacked chevrons. Same gray color for every level. Each rank has its own uniform 24x32 tile, bottom aligned, flat geometric silhouette. Level 0 is visibly present, never blank or hidden. Chevron count must be exactly 1 / 2 / 3.
Composition: landscape review board, approx 1536x1024. Background solid warm ivory #F5F2E9, ink #706F68, dark charcoal typography #30332F, fine neutral rules, ample whitespace, precise editorial grid. Render Simplified Chinese text accurately.
Top left large title exactly “基因唤醒”. Subtitle exactly “类型 × 等级 · 两套独立素材”.
Upper section label “01  基因类型”. Show only two generously spaced large type emblems, native left, mutated right, with labels exactly “原生” and “异变”. Under them one small text line “轮廓区分类型，不绑定等级”.
Middle section label “02  唤醒等级”. Show four evenly spaced rank emblems 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 in their exact construction described above. Under each respectively “0级” “1级” “2级” “3级”. One small text line “空心核 → 一道共振 → 两道共振 → 三道共振”.
Lower left section label “03  独立组合”. Show two small bloodline-style rounded ivory UI boxes, with gray header “血脉”. In the first, place the MUTATED TYPE DNA icon, then label “异变”, then a subtle vertical divider and level-0 HOLLOW DIAMOND, then “0级”. In the second, NATIVE TYPE DNA icon, label “原生”, divider, THREE CHEVRONS, then “3级”. These demonstrate valid cross combinations. Supporting line exactly “异变可以是0级，原生也可以是3级”.
Lower right section label “04  界面落位”. Place the supplied UI screenshot inset about 480px wide, preserve its visible “等级 1 /10”, attack72 defense46 life205, headers and adjacent traits, only remove red annotation marks. Inside the blank bloodline panel insert MUTATED DNA + “异变” | HOLLOW DIAMOND + “0级”, compact 28–32px icons proportionate to attack pictogram. Keep no other new game interface changes.
Tiny footer “类型图标 32px  /  等级图标 24px  /  单色可读”. Production-minded presentation, clear exact counts, no extraneous text.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / game UI sprite sheet. Edit the provided approved gene-awakening concept board into ONE production-style TRANSPARENT TYPE ICON SPRITE SHEET. Extract and faithfully redraw ONLY the two pictograms in section "01 基因类型": native DNA double helix on the left, mutated broken DNA helix with central hollow diamond and upper-right lightning bolt on the right. Preserve these exact approved silhouettes and broad angular stroke style; no redesign. Remove all typography, grid lines, panels, other icons, background and labels. Single perfectly uniform solid warm graphite color #706F68 on all opaque interiors. Clean hard edges with antialiasing, absolutely no shadow, shading, white border, texture, matte, glow or background. ACTUAL TRANSPARENT alpha canvas, not a drawn checkerboard. Canvas landscape aspect ratio 2:1, ideally 1024x512. Two equal 512x512 square cells side by side; left symbol centered exactly at (256,256), right centered exactly at (768,256). Each entire icon fits within a 300x300 box centered inside its cell, the DNA backbone height is 260px for both, mutated lightning also stays inside its 300x300 box. Even generous transparent padding. Only these TWO disconnected types, left native / right mutated. No level chevrons, no text, no footer. This is the independent gene TYPE layer, no ranks.

Use case: precise-object-edit / game UI sprite sheet. Edit the provided approved gene-awakening concept board into ONE production-style TRANSPARENT LEVEL ICON SPRITE SHEET. Extract and faithfully redraw ONLY the four pictograms in section "02 唤醒等级": 0 a hollow diamond, 1 a single broad solid upward chevron, 2 exactly two identical separate stacked chevrons, 3 exactly three identical separate stacked chevrons. Preserve the approved geometric shape language. SINGLE uniform solid warm graphite #706F68 in opaque interiors, no differences in color between ranks. ACTUAL TRANSPARENT alpha background; not a drawn checkerboard. Remove all text, labels, panels, grids, type icons, backgrounds and everything else. Square 1024x1024 canvas, a perfectly regular 2-by-2 sprite grid, each cell 512x512. Row-major ordering top-left level0 / top-right level1 / bottom-left level2 / bottom-right level3. Each entire pictogram centered horizontally within its own cell. All four fit the same 280x280 inner box with bottom baseline y=396 in the top row and y=908 in bottom row. Each chevron exactly same width 240px, shape and thickness in every rank, vertical pitch90px. For level1 use the bottom chevron only, level2 use the bottom two, level3 all three. Each chevron is an UPWARD pointing roof/peak ∧ with broad flat filled bars; independent separated silhouettes, no connecting stem. The hollow diamond for level0 is 190x190 centered horizontally, bottom aligned at the same baseline, with a substantial 34px stroke and clear empty center. Transparent safety margin around every cell. No shadows, glow, gradient, 3D, white outline, textures, frame, numbers, text or legend. Exact chevron counts 1 / 2 / 3 are CRITICAL. This is the independent awakening LEVEL layer; NO DNA motifs.
